items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And Sister Cage, that's his number, you know. The real title of it is Keep Off Cady's Head, you know. That's his number.

ctx.x: What kind of tunes did he play with you? Who?
Louie, when he sat in like that. He played Ole Miss. Ole Miss. And Sister Cage, that's his number, you know. The real title of it is Keep Off Cady's Head, you know. That's his number.
That's what, I know Louie says he wrote it.
